Hi Amit — thanks for sending the PO. Quick answers and next steps below.

- We can invoice Crestline EU Limited, yes — we’ll need the exact legal entity name and VAT ID to populate the invoice.
- Net60 is doable but requires finance sign-off for this committed renewal; our standard for similar renewals has been Net45. I’ve looped in Ben from Billing to confirm final terms.
- Please attach the VAT registration and confirm whether the PO should be applied to the committed capacity line item or split across committed + overage.

I’ve attached the latest SOW (v3) that reflects the additional capacity and pricing — once we have the signed SOW and the updated PO with entity details we’ll issue a proforma invoice and lock the billing entity.

Attachment: Redwood_SOW_v3.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 45KB)

1) Confirm legal entity name + VAT ID (reply to this thread)
